params.name: id
params.description: ID of the employee to be queried.

params.name: visible
params.description: Visible to the employee. Default: false

params.name: signable_by_legal_agent
params.description: Requires the signature of the legal representative. Default: false

params.name: signable_by_second_legal_agent
params.description: Requires the signature of a second legal representative. Default: false

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Overwrite file. Applies only to documents that do not have all required signatures. Default: false

params.name: start_signature_workflow
params.description: Start automatic signature flow The document must be visible and must have signature or review requirements to select this option. Default: false

params.name: path
params.description: Path where the file will be saved. If left blank it will be created in the employee's root folder. Example: personal/security

params.name: signatures
params.description: Array of objects of signature type. It is an optional parameter. If this parameter is used, the other parameters related to the signature will not be taken into account.

params.name: reviewer_id
params.description: Person's ID of the reviewer. This is an optional parameter, if you do not want to assign a reviewer, leave this field empty

We receive a document, which will be related to the employee.

**Permisos requeridos para utilizar este endpoint:** 
* Permissions to upload documents en: 'Sí'.

The possible file IDs are in the GET `/employees/{id}/docs` endpoint.

The redirection for the entered document of file_id is returned, hence it must be followed.

* To follow the redirection, add the ‘-L’ option.
* To save the response in a file, add the ‘-o’ option and pass the file name.

**Example**
````curl -L -X GET --header 'Accept: */*' --header 'auth_token: [AUTH TOKEN]' 'http://www.[COMPANY SUBDOMAIN].buk.cl/api/v1/employees/1/docs/1156' -o [FILE NAME]````
